description: Free and paid search providers used by the research engine (Serper, DuckDuckGo, RSS, HackerNews) and their reliability characteristics.

entries.bad_pattern: Relying on the DuckDuckGo HTML scraper (html.duckduckgo.com/html) as the key-less fallback for the web/news search providers and assuming it yields real product sources
entries.good_pattern: Treat SERPER_API_KEY as effectively required for real runs; the DDG fallback currently returns 0 parseable results (anti-bot block / changed page markup), so without Serper the pipeline gathers ~1 source and synth fails with 'No reliable products found'
entries.description: Verified 2026-06-11 on a real instant-tier run ('best budget mechanical keyboard under 100'): with OPENROUTER_API_KEY set but no SERPER_API_KEY, every web/news/duckduckgo search logged '[ddg] q parsed -> 0 results'. A live curl of html.duckduckgo.com/html returned no result__a / uddg= markers at all, confirming DDG no longer returns parseable results to the scraper. Only RSS and HackerNews remained functional, yielding 1 source, so the engine completed but synth correctly threw 'No reliable products found for this query.' The pipeline itself is wired correctly (LLM calls fire, cost_usd and synth_model are recorded even on failure, budget governor + rate limiter + tier defaulting all work). The structural gap is search coverage: provide a SERPER_API_KEY for real product runs, or replace/repair the free fallback (DDG parser or an alternative free SERP).
entries.context: worker/engine/tools.js executeSearch web/news provider fallback; worker/lib/duckduckgo.js parseResults

entries.bad_pattern: Standing up self-hosted SearXNG and expecting the JSON API + all engines to work out of the box
entries.good_pattern: Enable JSON format, provide the secret via SEARXNG_SECRET env (not yaml), curate engines with keep_only + disabled:false, and drop datacenter-IP-blocked engines
entries.description: SearXNG (self-hosted on blackbox, the 'searxng' provider) setup traps, all hit 2026-06-26: (1) JSON API is OFF by default -> need search.formats:[html,json] in settings.yml or every format=json request 403s. (2) server.secret_key IN YAML is rejected on the 2026.6 image ('not a str') -> provide via SEARXNG_SECRET env var instead. (3) The container chowns its config dir to uid 977 so the host user can't overwrite settings.yml -> edit via 'docker cp <file> searxng:/etc/searxng/settings.yml' then restart. (4) Curate engines via use_default_settings.engines.keep_only:[...]; many (bing/mojeek/qwant/reddit) are disabled:true by default and need explicit per-engine disabled:false. (5) From a datacenter/homelab IP: duckduckgo->CAPTCHA, qwant->403, reddit->403 (all unusable); working set = google+startpage+bing+mojeek (+brave when not 429'd); mojeek needs ~8s timeout. (6) SearXNG aggregates engines so it is slower than a single API -> give searxngSearch an 11s ceiling (vs the shared 8s TIMEOUT_MS) and cap SearXNG's internal outgoing.max_request_timeout at 9s.

entries.bad_pattern: Assuming one web-search provider yields meaningfully higher-quality sources than another for product research
entries.good_pattern: Treat Serper/Brave/Tavily/SearXNG as ~equal on source credibility; pick on cost + reliability, and run several in parallel for recall
entries.description: Provider benchmark (benchmarks/bench-providers.mjs, 2026-06-26, 20 real Google queries scored with the real scoreSource credibility fn): all four providers landed at ~43-45 avg credibility -> a dead heat on per-source quality (they index the same web). The wins are elsewhere: SearXNG (free, self-hosted) ties the paid providers, and the UNION of all four yields +50-65% more unique sources at equal quality. None surface structured product/price/ASIN data (~10-13% price, ~1 ASIN) -> that needs a Shopping endpoint, not a web-search provider. Brave's free tier rate-limits hard (9/20 fails under a parallel burst). Implication: lean on Serper (Google-fidelity) + SearXNG (free breadth); Tavily/Brave are fallbacks.
